frontmatter.description: Discover the high-value context sources available in this adopter's environment (chat, email, calendar, transcripts, task trackers) and generate the vault tooling to access them. Use once per new environment, or when the owner's toolchain changes.

frontmatter.title: Skill: Agent Orientation

headings.text: Integration preference ladder (apply at every step)

frontmatter.description: Create or update today's daily journal log from the vault template. Use when asked to start the day, log something to today, or append to the daily note — invocation itself directs the write to 03_Journal/periodic/daily/.
frontmatter.name: daily-log
frontmatter.title: Skill: Daily Log

frontmatter.description: Capture new content into the vault's Inbox as a correctly formatted note. Use whenever you produce output for the vault and no explicit destination was given — the Inbox-first rule makes 02_Inbox/ the default landing zone.
frontmatter.name: inbox-capture
frontmatter.title: Skill: Inbox Capture

frontmatter.description: Find and fix broken or fragile wikilinks using the brain index's resolution data and repair hints. Use when validate reports unresolved links, after files move or rename, or on request.
frontmatter.name: link-repair
frontmatter.title: Skill: Link Repair

frontmatter.description: Install this vault's agent primitives into a coding harness's user-level config — symlink-first — and wire the harness's memory file to import the vault entrypoint. Use when setting up Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Pi, Cursor, Copilot, or Muse Code to use this vault everywhere, or to re-sync or uninstall a previous install.
frontmatter.name: onboard-harness
frontmatter.title: Skill: Onboard Harness

frontmatter.description: Run a weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly review from the matching vault template, pre-filled from what actually happened. Use when asked for any cadence of review; the cadence is a parameter, not a separate skill.
frontmatter.name: periodic-review
frontmatter.title: Skill: Periodic Review

frontmatter.description: Propose and wire recurring ingestion flows — email digests, calendar context, chat capture — into 02_Inbox/ using this harness's own scheduling mechanism. Use after agent-orientation has established which sources exist, or when the owner asks for recurring capture.
frontmatter.name: recommended-automations
frontmatter.title: Skill: Recommended Automations

frontmatter.description: Turn a research task into a durable reference note in 06_Resources/ (or an atomic zettel) with explicit provenance. Use when asked to research a topic for the vault — invocation directs the write to 06_Resources/.
frontmatter.name: research-to-resource
frontmatter.title: Skill: Research to Resource

frontmatter.description: Audit the agent-generated skills, tools, and automations over time — validate, prune dead sources, update for upstream changes, and propose promotions or archival to the owner. Use on a recurring cadence (monthly fits the review rhythm) or after any environment change.
frontmatter.name: self-maintenance
frontmatter.title: Skill: Self Maintenance

frontmatter.description: Record a solved problem in the 10_Agents/solutions/ knowledge base so no agent re-derives it. Use immediately after solving anything non-obvious that could recur — this is a standing carve-out from the Inbox-first rule.
frontmatter.name: solution-capture
frontmatter.title: Skill: Solution Capture

frontmatter.description: Classify the notes sitting in 02_Inbox/ and propose a PARA destination for each, for human review. Use when asked to triage, clean up, or process the Inbox — the skill proposes moves but never performs them.
frontmatter.name: triage-inbox
frontmatter.title: Skill: Triage Inbox

frontmatter.description: Run the vault's health checks, fix what they find, and keep the status and changelog snapshots current. Use for "check the vault", "clean up", or as a recurring hygiene pass.
frontmatter.name: vault-maintenance
frontmatter.title: Skill: Vault Maintenance
